This could lead to potential errors in the search process, such as missing relevant information or not properly parsing the results. In conclusion, assigning the InformationExtraction_Expert to this task might not be the optimal choice because their skills may not fully align with the requirements of the task, potentially leading to inaccuracies or inefficiencies.
